The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1917–1918''' was contested by 51 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]], [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]], [[Amsterdamsche FC|AFC]] and [[Be Quick 1887]].
